name: softube-tape-drum-tight
description: Tight + modern drum-bus tape via Softube Tape. Type A (most transparent — measured centroid 2212 ≈ dry) at 30 IPS (brightest + tightest lows — centroid 2404, lowest low-ratio), Amount 5 for light glue, Crosstalk OFF to keep the image open. The punchy/bright counterpart to softube-tape-drum-glue-warm.
intended_for: a drum bus that should stay tight, present and modern (not fattened). Insert before the master; do NOT limit here.
plugin_build: Softube 'Tape.vst3' (renders headless via Pedalboard; iLok/PACE — authorized on this rig, re-verify elsewhere). String-enum params → this harness only.
notes: 30 IPS measured BRIGHTEST + tightest lows; Type A is the cleanest machine — minimal coloration, only the light compression of Amount 5 (crest ~ -0.2 dB).
Too clean? Move to Type C (a touch more top + organic LF) or push Amount to 6-7. Want air? high_freq_trim toward BOOST.
Verify crest/PLR (glue, not squash), centroid (should stay bright), render-ab. Sibling: [[softube-transient-shaper]] for transient design, [[api-vision-channel-strip]] for console punch.
